title: Simple Mode
notes: New: Simple Mode (on by default). Enhancing never fails, Common junk is salvaged automatically and your Legion picks its strongest party and stars up on its own.
Simple Mode also hides the CHAIN counter in fights (the bonus still works), so you can focus on STRIKE, PARRY and skills.
Want full control? Turn Simple Mode off in the menu (Esc) at any time. Everything switches back.
